extensionDescription.message: Save academic documents, metadata, collections, and tags directly to your local Nodus Library.

detectingHint.message: Reading only the active tab after your click.

connectHint.message: Open Nodus, enable the Chrome connector in Settings → Integrations, then approve this browser once.

cannotReachNodus.message: Nodus could not be reached on port $PORT$. Open Nodus and use the port shown in Settings → Integrations.

webSnapshotHint.message: Keep a local copy of this page with the reference.

savedSummary.message: $ATTACHMENTCOUNT$ file(s) are now attached. Clean reading preparation continues in Nodus.

unsupportedPage.message: Open a regular web page or document (HTTP/HTTPS), then click the Nodus icon again.

noPageData.message: Chrome did not provide the page metadata.

enableInNodus.message: Enable Nodus Connector in Nodus → Settings → Integrations first.

libraryNotReady.message: Choose a backup folder in Nodus first so the local nodus-library folder can be created.

portHint.message: Use the port shown in Nodus → Settings → Integrations.

pairingForgotten.message: Pairing removed. Nodus will ask for approval next time.
